name: landmine single arm push press
description: A one-arm push press with a landmine, using leg drive to move the bar up and the shoulder to control it.
instructions: Stand facing the landmine end and hold it at your shoulder with one hand.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees.
Drive up with your legs and press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower the end back to your shoulder with control.
Keep your ribs down and brace your core. Finish the reps, then switch arms.
